reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis proposes a processing route (HEBM+SPS) to increase hardness/strength, but it does not explain the low hardness/strength of the starting simple solid-solution state, which is the core of the research question.
reasons.testability: The falsification test only checks if the predicted high hardness is achieved, not whether the proposed mechanisms (grain boundary, dislocation, solid solution strengthening) govern the low strength of the baseline material.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses how to increase strength rather than explaining the origin of the low strength in the equimolar solid-solution state, making it largely off-topic for the stated research question.
